members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: buildWellKnownPath/buildDiscoveryUrls only stripped a single trailing slash (`pathname.endsWith('/') ? slice(0,-1) : pathname`), which leaves a trailing slash when the input pathname has multiple trailing slashes (e.g. '/foo//'), producing malformed discovery URLs like '/foo//.well-known/oauth-authorization-server'.
